findings.title: 12 deprecation(s) triggered, 1 distinct
findings.detail: Most frequent (12×): GeneralUtility::getIndpEnv() is deprecated since TYPO3 v14.3 and will be removed in TYPO3 v15.0. Use NormalizedParams from the PSR-7 request instead. in GeneralUtility.php:2148
findings.whenThisIsFine: Deprecations cost little at runtime, but each one is code that breaks with the next major TYPO3 version. Fix them before the upgrade, not during it.
findings.fix: follow the changelog entry named in the message; `typo3/cms-install`'s upgrade scanner finds the same patterns statically.
